content: 由于决赛紧张激烈耗时较长，于大比分2:2，决胜场局比分1:1时学校体育馆定时熄灯，导致比赛无法继续进行。经双方队员、裁判组、社团干部共同商议决定，本次比赛决赛双方共享冠军，铜牌赛胜败双方分别获得亚军和季军。祝贺四强所有队伍！今日比赛比分将稍晚发布。另外，为保证充足的期中复习时间，单打比赛剩余赛程全部于期中考试后进行，预祝大家考试顺利，比赛顺利！

content_en: The final was tense and ran long; with the overall score at 2:2 and the deciding match at 1:1 games, the school gymnasium lights went out on schedule, so the match could not be continued. After joint consultation by both teams, the umpiring crew and the club officers, the two sides were decided as joint champions of this final, while the winner and loser of the bronze-medal match take the runner-up and third places respectively. Congratulations to all four semifinalists! Today's match scores will be posted a little later. In addition, in order to leave everyone enough time to revise for the mid-term exams, all remaining singles fixtures will be played after the exams. Good luck with your exams and with your matches!
